```{r setup-mascot_palettes, include = FALSE, echo = FALSE}
studio_character <- if (exists("studio_character")) studio_character else formals(mascot::mascot)$character
```

```{r mascot_palettes-try-live, echo = FALSE}
if (!in_studio()) guide_try_live("mascot_palettes")
```

```{r mascot_palettes-heading, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
guide_heading(paste0(mascot::mascot_character(studio_character)$name, "'s palettes"), "Palettes")
```

<div class="pg-muted">

The first row is the character's own colours, with no palette applied; "original" always selects them.

</div>

```{r mascot_palettes-table, echo = FALSE}
guide_each_character(function(ch) guide_table(mascot::mascot_palettes(ch), wrap = "pg-palette-table"))
```

```{r mascot_palettes-notes, child = file.path(guide_dir, "_palette-notes.Rmd"), echo = FALSE}
```

```{r mascot_palettes-base-demo, echo = FALSE}
if (in_studio()) palette_base_demo(studio_character)
```

```{r mascot_palettes-outline-demo, echo = FALSE}
if (in_studio()) dark_outline_demo(studio_character)
```

```{r mascot_palettes-roles-demo, echo = FALSE}
if (in_studio()) palette_roles_demo()
```

```{r mascot_palettes-swap-demo, echo = FALSE}
if (in_studio()) palette_swap_section(studio_character)
```

